purpose: Artifact-level index for public implementations, experiments, receipts, reproduction commands, and explicit evidence gaps. This is separate from the idea index.

records.metric_boundary: bounded Rust unit tests, policy gates, and Rust Vulkan smoke; not a full-model performance result
records.notes: Production path is Rust plus shader/SPIR-V and OS/Vulkan driver libraries. Model payloads are not bundled.

records.metric_boundary: dependency/source/linked-object/exec tracing; not a claim that every research worktree is Rust-only
records.notes: The public audit records no helper process execution and identifies the allowed Vulkan loader/driver boundary.

records.metric_boundary: identity/configuration/observed smoke telemetry; not a universal or sustained full-model envelope
records.notes: Factory, configured, observed, historical, and unknown fields are kept separate.

records.metric_boundary: D32A block geometry and deterministic vector round trip; not full-model compatibility or GPU throughput
records.notes: The public KAT is clean-room Rust and intentionally does not import the legacy C++ implementation.

records.metric_boundary: logical prefill diagnostic rows/s; not generation tokens/s
records.notes: The clean ubatch=512 nine-point logical-prefill-row series and malformed ubatch=4096 boundary are published. No measured logical prefill-row W4096 point was found.

records.metric_boundary: profile byte accounting, codec round trip, page identity, and corruption rejection; not model quality
records.notes: The profile receipt is model-free. A model-quality frontier remains a separate, non-closed artifact.

records.metric_boundary: model-quality/perplexity/attention parity is not represented by the storage KAT
records.notes: Private model runs and raw receipts were not cleared for publication; no public quality result is asserted.

records.metric_boundary: addressable representation and adversarial probe accounting; not dense 10M attention or semantic retrieval
records.notes: Semantic R@10 is null by design; the public fixture cannot be used as a semantic-quality claim.

records.metric_boundary: synthetic acceptance bookkeeping; not a neural model quality or speedup result
records.notes: Historical 240/263 and approximately 3.16 anchors are explicitly not claimed by this synthetic fixture.

records.metric_boundary: synthetic replay acceptance; throughput is not measured
records.notes: Historical n-gram throughput anchors are not promoted.

records.metric_boundary: independent committed work validation; not instruction activity, TOPS, or LLM throughput
records.notes: The apparent useful-throughput result is retained as negative knowledge and rejected as a performance claim.

records.metric_boundary: historical tokens/s comparison is a cautionary summary, not a current public benchmark
records.notes: The public index does not claim exact reproduction because the original model/runtime/receipt combination is not public-safe.

records.metric_boundary: format/bring-up documentation; not full-model generation readiness
records.notes: Full-model first-token and generation gates remain incomplete; claim C-010 is invalidated.

records.metric_boundary: specification and research notes; only D32A geometry has a public KAT
records.notes: Other family labels are not silently treated as implemented or interoperable formats.

records.metric_boundary: architecture/design notes; no public model-quality or throughput receipt
records.notes: The public implementation map points to bounded Rust structures; private model runs are not promoted.

records.metric_boundary: research ideas and formal queues; no implication of measured implementation
records.notes: The technical index does not substitute idea records for implementation or experiment receipts.

records.metric_boundary: bounded Rust accounting and invariant tests; not full-model generation, throughput, quality, or energy evidence
records.notes: The native controller and its runtime observation bridges are public Rust. Unknown critical inputs fail closed; exactness and model-level claims remain separate.

records.metric_boundary: documented negative knowledge; only the SWMMAC accumulator case has a runnable public KAT
records.notes: Other counterexamples remain public research records rather than being represented as runnable experiments.

records.metric_boundary: Reference-machine deployment measurements with an excluded model payload and executing runtime branch: coherence, 12/12 canaries, sustained 128-token completions, 262144-token Q8 KV capacity, a matched control/prefetch pair, the route distribution, and the BF16-derived V2 hot-region configuration. No quality retention, 384K, MTP, or resident-throughput result.
records.notes: Model payload, scaffold container, executing research runtime branch, and raw receipts are excluded, so this lane is a bounded disposition rather than a runnable benchmark. The executing runtime is an external research branch, not part of HAR, and HAR does not depend on it.

records.metric_boundary: Tensor- and activation-level fidelity (weight relRMS against the BF16 authority tensor; Frobenius activation error on captured routed-MoE inputs) over a 9-slice panel, plus one off-budget residual island. Not capability, quality, or whole-model evidence; teacher-KL was not captured.
records.notes: Two defects found while publishing are recorded in the receipt and in research/representation/README.md: a float32 byte-count unit error (1433600 B versus the correct 358400 B) and a donor activation error previously printed in a weight relRMS column.

records.metric_boundary: Model identity, artifact composition, host/device expert split and explicit host arena. Not a runnable public benchmark: weights and container bytes are excluded.
records.notes: The invalidated 99.536% hit-rate figure is retained as a correction record; the corrected range is 98.545-98.771% at 16 GiB.

records.metric_boundary: Backend-labelled decode records (Vulkan historical 18.430 with an 18.360 re-anchor; ROCm/HIP raw K0 15.374-15.422) and the prefill record including the 662.7437 hot run. Raw, accepted and prefill rates are never blended.
records.notes: 18.430 is the historical Vulkan configuration of record, not current HIP performance; 662.7437 is a hot-run measurement.

records.metric_boundary: MTP rollback correctness (KAT 276/682 failing to 0/682, greedy parity at K=0/2/3/4) plus the staging/overlap programme's measured null. Correctness and the null are separate conclusions.
records.notes: The KAT is a model-free test in an unpublished tree; the overlap result is a null, not a win.

records.metric_boundary: Local worker packaging: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, lifecycle commands, health checks, agent-harness integration, native 262144 context with host-RAM KV. Capability boundary is a base checkpoint with no chat template.
records.notes: Packaging only; no quality, capability or long-context quality claim.

records.metric_boundary: Single-layer expert-major grouping (0.185 to 6.115 TMAC/s), bit-exact same-kernel parity, and the retired CPU-MoE prefill regression. Local kernel measurement, not a full-model multiplier.
records.notes: The Amdahl ceiling for this lever is ~1.65x and the deployed-configuration gate returned REVERT.

records.metric_boundary: ROCm/HIP block-stationary host-KV reuse: physical host read at the link roof with logical service scaling with reuse width, exact-attention parity, and the registered-host-memory prerequisite.
records.notes: Logical bandwidth is not physical bandwidth; the two arms disagree at K>=32 and the registered-pageable JSON receipt is absent from disk.

records.metric_boundary: Engine-level production context behaviour: 262144 with host-RAM KV against 114688 with VRAM KV, with pinning and async staging as measured nulls and a Vulkan control.
records.notes: The 8.4-8.7 row exists as a ledger table rather than a machine-readable receipt; the reuse kernel is not integrated.

records.metric_boundary: The HIP ladder (raw K0 17.35; accepted 29.19/34.25/33.90 at K=1/2/4), the iq4_nl KV defect, and the wide-M verification bandwidth decay. Raw, accepted and prefill rates are separate columns.
records.notes: The historical 42.11 belongs to a different artifact, backend and session; 34.25 and 42.11 must not be merged.

records.metric_boundary: Symbolic action memory on the cold tier: frozen-panel hit/miss A/B, the retraction of the 5.10x headline, the admissible 1.771x clean multiplier, and packed-extent I/O reduction.
records.notes: The 5.10x headline is retracted as contaminated; the token/forward figures are a timing proxy.

records.metric_boundary: Measured rejections and retractions: Laya sidecar, 100k raw decode, structured sparsity, ALICE_MOE_BLOCK, F2 copy stream, CPU-MoE prefill, coarse double staging, and the campaign's internal retractions.
records.notes: Rejections of specific implementations and configurations; directions closed by physics are labelled as such.

records.metric_boundary: Utilization-first representation research: the measured unpack-cost ordering, modelled per-weight ALU estimates, the pc4 projection, GSQ/RCO prior art, and the modelled Flash-Next compression target.
records.notes: Only the unpack ordering is measured; everything else is modelled or projected and no GSQ/RCO synthesis is implemented.

closure.interpretation: Zero orphaned claims does not mean every historical result is rerunnable; blocked and unrecoverable evidence is named above.
